topics.name: Whole-Tree Reconciliation Readiness Profile
topics.purpose: Define repository/closure-level requirements that must pass before contracts may be proposed for locked status after reconciliation.

semantics.identity_rule: Each reconciliation readiness profile has explicit identity/version.
semantics.exception_rule: Allowed exceptions must be explicit, scoped, owned and optionally expiring.
semantics.scope_rule: Profile applies to exact repository/closure set.
semantics.lock_rule: Readiness pass makes lock transition eligible only; it does not modify status.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.
